tools.name: studio_templates_list

tools.name: studio_catalog_bricks
tools.description: List the GridGarden Brick Premium modular components — middle and TOP planks in XS–XL sizes (plus a 1200mm XXL TOP) and the connector pin — with live EUR unit prices and availability from Shopify. Brick Premium only; no other materials are sold. Read-only.

tools.name: studio_bom_to_cart

Computes the exact bill of materials, maps it to the live Brick Premium product variants, and creates an ANONYMOUS cart — no account, login
